name: preview-judge-logo-crown
command: node -e "const {spawnSync:s}=require('node:child_process');for(const a of process.argv.slice(1)){const [b,...r]=JSON.parse(a);const p=s(b==='node'?process.execPath:b,r,{stdio:'inherit'});if(p.status!==0)process.exit(1)}" "[\"node\", \"--experimental-strip-types\", \"tools/uiPreview.ts\", \"logo.crown\", \"normal\"]" "[\"python3\", \"$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT\", \"out/ui-preview/logo.crown.normal.png\", \"--description\", \"Royal Fiesta game logo: glossy gold inflatable crown with gem balls above the words ROYAL FIESTA in chunky rounded letters on a pink inflatable band, SDF Modeler preview on a sky background\", \"--reference\", \"/refs/ref-1.png\", \"--min-score\", \"6\", \"--aspect\", \"design\"]"

name: judge-button-secondary-normal

name: preview-judge-bars
command: node -e "const {spawnSync:s}=require('node:child_process');const j=process.argv[1];const d={'bar.track':process.argv[2],'bar.progress':process.argv[3]};let bad=0;for(const id in d){const p=s(process.execPath,['--experimental-strip-types','tools/uiPreview.ts',id,'normal'],{stdio:'inherit'});if(p.status!==0){bad=1;continue}const r=s('python3',[j,'out/ui-preview/'+id+'.normal.png','--description',d[id],'--min-score','6'],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('[bars] '+id+' judge exit '+r.status);if(r.status!==0)bad=1}process.exit(bad)" "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" "A game UI progress-bar track seen alone on a sky-blue background, in the glossy inflatable toy style of the reference (bright plastic, Fall Guys-like): a long horizontal pill-shaped inflatable tube in pale lilac with a puffy white-highlighted rim, rounded caps and a recessed groove inside it with a soft darker inner shadow along the top of the groove. It is empty: no fill and no text." "A game UI progress-bar fill seen alone on a sky-blue background, in the glossy inflatable toy style of the reference (bright plastic, Fall Guys-like): a long horizontal pill-shaped glossy inflatable tube that blends from hot pink at the top to orange at the bottom, with a bright white highlight streak along the top, a darker magenta rim and rounded caps. No text."
